title: Perceptual presence is the way sensory events can take over control

statements.text: How present an experience seems, its imposingness, can be identified with the degree and way in which sensory events, through innate attention-grabbing mechanisms, make the perceiver lose control of the exploratory activity that experiencing consists in.

sources.quote: can be identified with the degree and way in which sensory events can make us lose control of the exploratory activity that constitutes experiencing
